financial difficulties: After his father lost his job, the family faced serious financial difficulties and could not pay the rent.
他父親失業後，全家面臨嚴重的財務困難，付不出房租。
the financial year: The company's profits rose by ten percent in the financial year that ended in March.
這家公司在三月結束的會計年度裡利潤成長了百分之十。
financial support: Her uncle gave her financial support, sending her money every month so she could pay for college.
她舅舅給她經濟援助，每個月寄錢給她，讓她付得起大學學費。
the financial crisis: Many banks closed and millions of people lost their homes during the financial crisis of 2008.
在2008年的金融危機期間，許多銀行倒閉，數百萬人失去了房子。
financial statements: Before investing in the company, you should read its financial statements carefully to check its income and debts.
投資這家公司之前，你應該仔細閱讀它的財務報表，查看收入和負債。
fiscal policy: The government changed its fiscal policy, cutting taxes and spending more on public roads and bridges.
政府改變了財政政策，減稅並增加公共道路和橋梁的支出。
the fiscal year: In Taiwan, the government's fiscal year begins in January, so the new budget must be passed before then.
在台灣，政府的會計年度從一月開始，所以新預算必須在那之前通過。
a fiscal deficit: The country has a large fiscal deficit because the government spends far more money than it collects in taxes.
這個國家有龐大的財政赤字，因為政府的支出遠超過稅收。
flexible working hours: My mom's company offers flexible working hours, so she can start late and still pick me up from school.
我媽媽的公司提供彈性工時，所以她可以晚點上班，還能來學校接我。
a flexible approach: Good teachers take a flexible approach, changing their lessons to suit students who learn in different ways.
好老師會採取靈活的做法，調整課程以配合學習方式不同的學生。
be flexible about: I'm flexible about the meeting time, so we can meet at any hour that works for you.
我對開會時間保持彈性，所以任何你方便的時間我們都可以見面。
a flexible schedule: Freelancers enjoy a flexible schedule, so they can work at night and take days off whenever they want.
自由工作者享有彈性的時間表，所以他們可以晚上工作，想休假就休假。
be fluent in Japanese: After living in Tokyo for five years, she is fluent in Japanese and can chat easily with anyone.
在東京住了五年後，她日語流利，能輕鬆地和任何人聊天。
speak fluent English: Although he grew up in Taiwan, he can speak fluent English because he studied in Canada for years.
雖然他在台灣長大，但他能說一口流利的英語，因為他在加拿大讀了好幾年書。
a fluent writer: She is a fluent writer whose essays are smooth and easy to read, with no awkward sentences at all.
她是個文筆流暢的作家，文章通順易讀，完全沒有彆扭的句子。
a fluid situation: The typhoon's path changes every hour, so it is a fluid situation and our plans may change at any time.
颱風路徑每小時都在變，所以局勢變動不定，我們的計畫隨時可能改變。
fluid movements: The dancer's fluid movements looked as smooth as water flowing down a gentle river.
那位舞者流暢的動作看起來就像緩緩流下的河水一樣順暢。
fluid boundaries: Many young musicians enjoy the fluid boundaries between pop, jazz, and rock, mixing styles freely in one song.
許多年輕音樂人喜歡流行、爵士和搖滾之間不固定的界線，在一首歌裡自由混搭風格。
body fluids: Nurses must wear gloves when touching blood or other body fluids to avoid catching diseases.
護理師接觸血液或其他體液時必須戴手套，以免感染疾病。
not have the foggiest idea: I do not have the foggiest idea where I left my keys; I've looked everywhere in the house.
我一點也不知道鑰匙放在哪裡了；我把家裡每個地方都找遍了。
a foggy memory: Grandpa has only a foggy memory of his childhood village because he left it when he was three.
爺爺對童年的村莊只有模糊的記憶，因為他三歲時就離開了。
be fond of children: My aunt is very fond of children, so she became a kindergarten teacher and loves playing with her students.
我阿姨很喜愛孩子，所以她當了幼兒園老師，很喜歡和學生玩。
fond memories: I have fond memories of summer vacations at my grandparents' farm, where we caught fish and ate watermelon.
我對在祖父母農場度過的暑假有美好的回憶，我們在那裡抓魚、吃西瓜。
a fond farewell: On the last day of school, the students said a fond farewell to their teacher, hugging her with tears in their eyes.
學期最後一天，學生們含著淚擁抱老師，和她依依不捨地告別。
a fond hope: Winning the lottery is a fond hope for many people, but the chances of it happening are almost zero.
中樂透是很多人天真的期望，但實現的機會幾乎是零。
be fortunate enough to: I was fortunate enough to meet my favorite singer at the airport, and she even signed my notebook.
我有幸在機場遇到我最喜歡的歌手，她甚至還在我的筆記本上簽名。
It is fortunate that…: It is fortunate that nobody was hurt when the old tree fell onto the empty playground last night.
幸好昨晚老樹倒在空無一人的操場上時，沒有人受傷。
the less fortunate: Every winter our class collects warm clothes and blankets to give to the less fortunate in our city.
每年冬天，我們班都會收集保暖衣物和毯子，送給本市較不幸的人。
a fortunate coincidence: It was a fortunate coincidence that my old friend was on the same train when I lost my wallet.
我弄丟錢包時，老朋友剛好也在同一班火車上，真是幸運的巧合。
